name: Domes Miramare Corfu
insider_take: This stunning clifftop retreat sits on the emerald coastline where Corfu's Venetian elegance meets contemporary luxury - a true jewel in The Luxury Collection crown.
whats_special: Perched dramatically on Moraitika's cliffs, this adult-only sanctuary offers unobstructed views of the Ionian Sea. The property seamlessly blends Corfu's rich Venetian and British colonial heritage with modern Greek hospitality. As a Luxury Collection property, guests enjoy exclusive Marriott STARS benefits including complimentary breakfast, room upgrades, and late checkout.
pro_tip: Book a sea-view suite during sunset hours - Corfu's western position creates some of the Mediterranean's most spectacular golden hour lighting, best viewed from your private terrace with a local Robola wine.
dont_miss: The nearby Achilleion Palace, once owned by Empress Elisabeth of Austria, is just 10 minutes away. For a true local experience, venture to Corfu's UNESCO World Heritage Old Town with its maze of Venetian alleyways, the iconic Liston promenade, and the impressive Spianada Square - Europe's largest town square.
pros: Adults-only sophisticated atmosphere with premium Luxury Collection standards
Stunning beachfront location on Corfu's pristine coastline
Marriott STARS Program benefits including room upgrades and resort credits
Contemporary Greek island design with luxury amenities and spa services
cons: Adults-only policy excludes families with children
